title: Modality-based attention and dual-stream multiple instance convolutional neural network for predicting microvascular invasion of hepatocellular carcinoma.
summary: Original full text, Methods/Results: modality attention plus dual-stream multiple-instance CNN used MRI to predict pathology-confirmed MVI in 283 HCC cases; 4:1 split and five-fold CV, reported AUC 0.7422. Retrospective diagnostic result; no clinical-outcome benefit claimed.
